prompt: Create an original 120 second acoustic swing jazz instrumental composition for travel montage, walking and urban exploration. Mood: moving, bright, relaxed. Instruments: acoustic guitar, violin, upright bass. Style: crisp rhythmic guitar and playful violin phrases. Tempo approximately 152 BPM; E minor. Main idea: a descending melody with an upward answer. Use a forward-moving motif and recurring short instrumental answers. Instrumental only. No vocals, no choir, no humming, no singing, no speech, no lyrics, no vocal samples. Do not imitate any existing artist or melody. [00:00-00:40] Establish the main idea immediately with the core ensemble. [00:40-01:20] Develop the motif with a complementary instrumental counterline, preserving the intended energy. [01:20-02:00] Return to the main idea and give a musically resolved ending with a short natural tail. Finish around 02:00.

description.en: A lively and cheerful acoustic piece featuring a prominent accordion melody, supported by rhythmic acoustic guitar, double bass, and light percussion. It has a playful, somewhat nostalgic European folk or jazz feel.
description.zh: 一首活泼欢快的原声乐曲，以手风琴为主旋律，配以节奏感强的原声吉他、低音提琴和轻柔的打击乐。整体感觉俏皮，略带怀旧的欧洲民间或爵士风情。
